Use the bubble or open Dictate & Delegate to control dictation.

• Your notes, audio, words and templates stay on this phone.
• To write down what you said, your recording goes straight to OpenRouter with your key, and on to the speech model's provider. The text goes the same way to Jev, a fast model that decides whether to refine it, with your template names. When it's refined, it goes to the text model, with what you told Dictate & Delegate about you, your words, the template you named and what you attached.
• If you connect bb, a task you hand to your chief of staff goes to your bb, with the text you pasted.
• Dictate & Delegate has no server and collects nothing. OpenRouter and the model providers handle the data under their own policies.

Dictate & Delegate uses Android\'s Accessibility permission for two things only: to put your text at the cursor when you tap Insert, and to notice when you hold the volume key you chose. It asks for no accessibility events and reads nothing on your screen; it looks up the text field you\'re typing in only when you tap Insert. Dictate & Delegate is open source, so you can check.
